reviews.title: Vibrant cultural fests and world-class sports facilities
reviews.body: Extracurricular opportunities are boundless. The annual tech and cultural fests attract colleges from all across India. High-speed Wi-Fi and 24/7 library are major plus points.

reviews.title: Rigorous academics with intense semester exams
reviews.body: The curriculum is quite demanding, and relative grading can be tough if you do not stay consistent. However, the placement cell makes sure you get good internship opportunities.

reviews.title: Excellent ROI and research opportunities
reviews.body: The return on investment is unparalleled compared to most private institutions. Professors are approachable and help students publish high-impact conference papers.
